### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

One first-hand Daily Nous commenter (2024) reported unusually responsive/proactive editorial communication (an apology email when review exceeded 6 months) despite the journal's "terrible reputation" among philosophers generally — a single anecdote, not a pattern. No SciRev page exists for this specific journal (SciRev only has pages for other philosophy titles, e.g. Australasian Journal of Philosophy, Journal of Philosophy of Education — confirmed not the same journal). No results found on 小木虫/muchong, 知乎, or Reddit r/AskAcademia specifically discussing this journal — philosophy submission culture on those Chinese platforms is thin/absent for this niche analytic-philosophy title.

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **preprint.allowed**: No preprint/self-archiving policy found on journalofphilosophy.org (memo to authors or elsewhere); general philosophy-field commentary (Philosophers' Cocoon, PhilSci-Archive policy pages) does not name this specific journal. Left null rather than assuming standard practice.
- **ai_policy.leniency numeric confidence**: Policy text is unambiguous (flat ban) but very short/terse — no separate disclosure clause, no distinction between drafting assistance vs. full composition, so nuance beyond '1=ban' can't be extracted; signal_quality capped at 2 because it's a single sentence from one page, not corroborated elsewhere.
- **positioning.methods_welcome breadth**: Could not retrieve a live table of contents or recent (2024-2026) article title list for journalofphilosophy.org itself (search kept surfacing the unrelated Journal of the History of Philosophy at jhp.wisc.edu). Only the memo's self-description ('sustained original contributions,' explicit exclusion of primarily historical/expository work and experimental philosophy) is confirmed; no CFP for a special issue found beyond the recurring Isaac Levi Prize.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture cross-language**: Zero results on 小木虫/muchong and 知乎 specifically naming this journal — Chinese academic-forum coverage of a narrow, invitation-poor analytic philosophy journal appears to be essentially nil; recorded honestly as 0 results rather than omitted.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- 小木虫 muchong.com (search: "Journal of Philosophy 投稿 审稿") — 0 results specific to this journal; forum has general submission-experience threads but none naming Journal of Philosophy (ISSN 0022-362X)
- 知乎 zhihu (same query) — 0 results specific to this journal
- Reddit r/AskAcademia (search: "Journal of Philosophy" review time desk reject) — 0 direct Reddit threads found; search only resurfaced the Daily Nous article
- SciRev.org — no journal page exists for this title (checked; SciRev has pages only for other philosophy journals such as Australasian Journal of Philosophy and Journal of Philosophy of Education, confirmed distinct from this journal)
